items.title: Kering turnaround hopes hit by drop in Gucci sales
items.summary: Philippine business desk picks up the Kering Q3 reaction: Gucci sales fell 6% (currency-adjusted) to EUR1.29bn on weak China footfall, with North America also slipping; CEO Luca de Meo pressing a five-year margin-doubling plan while closing stores (105 done, 125 planned by year-end). Notes recent creative-director exits at sister brands adding pressure on Demna in his first full year.

items.title: Gucci Visions debuts at EMSPHERE, Bangkok
items.summary: Bangkok Post covers the Gucci Visions pop-up exhibition opening at EMSPHERE mall, tracing the house's century of design across six themed rooms and over 200 handbag variations, part of Gucci's continued brand-heritage push into the Thai market.

items.title: Gucci Direct-Operated Retail Falls 9% in Q3 as Kering Extends China Market Adjustment Period to Two Years
items.summary: Critical-angle earnings follow-up: Gucci's direct retail sales fell 9% comparable in Q3; Kering CEO Luca de Meo warns the China action plan needs 12-24 months, avoiding broad discounting; Kering raised its 2026 net store-closure target to 125 (105 already done), a regional headwind relevant to SEA's shared APAC reporting bucket.

items.title: BILLKIN X GUCCI SS27 — fan account livestream post for Thai ambassador at Milan show
items.summary: Thai Gucci ambassador Billkin's fan/management account posts about his front-row appearance at Demna's Gucci SS27 "The Store Show" in Milan; one related post logged roughly 84.6K views and 71 likes, illustrating continued SEA fan engagement with Gucci ambassador content though outside the strict 7-day freshness window.

items.title: #guccithailand tag activity - Phuket boutique shopping/haul clips
items.summary: Ongoing TikTok tag (several thousand posts) features Thai creators filming shopping hauls and new-boutique visits at Gucci Central Phuket, reflecting grassroots retail-tourism buzz distinct from brand-run campaign content; exact per-video metrics not independently verifiable via aggregate tag page.

items.title: Hadiri Acara Gucci, Rizky Febian - Mahalini Tuai Pro Kontra karena Diduga Pro Israel
items.summary: Older but recurring critical-angle story (resurfaces periodically in Indonesian social chatter): Indonesian celebrity couple Rizky Febian and Mahalini faced boycott calls and unfollow campaigns after appearing at a Gucci event, over claims the brand is pro-Israel (claim unverified; Gucci does not appear on published BDS boycott lists). Included for context on recurring boycott-sentiment risk in Indonesia despite being outside the 14-day freshness window; flagged as background only, not counted toward today's fresh-item total.
